name: Terry Davis: Cleric and a Fighter
aliases: a normal person can't be a cleric and a fighter
description: Terry Davis, in a backwards cap under a big tree, says to the camera: "A normal person can't be a cleric and a fighter. Pretty schizophrenic, fuck yeah."
usage: Doing two incompatible jobs at once: the full-stack founder, the multiclass build, having it both ways.

source.author: @Davisanism
source.example: “A normal person can’t be a cleric and a fighter, but if you’re schizophrenic…”
